abort.plan_usage_not_granted: The ChatGPT plan usage permission (chatgpt.tokens.use.direct) was not granted. Sign in again and approve the use of your ChatGPT plan.

error.access_denied: The sign in was cancelled in the browser. Try again and approve access.
error.api_key_required: An API key is required when using API key authentication.
error.client_id_mismatch: The browser returned a different ChatGPT registration. Start the sign in again.
error.invalid_callback_url: This does not look like the URL your browser ended up on. Copy the full address from the browser address bar.
error.invalid_state: The sign in could not be verified (state mismatch). Start the sign in again.
error.registration_incomplete: The ChatGPT registration did not complete. Start the sign in again.
error.unexpected_error: Something went wrong while completing the sign in. Check the Home Assistant log and start the sign in again.
error.wrong_account: This sign in belongs to a different ChatGPT account than the entry being reauthenticated. Sign in with the account the entry was created with.

chatgpt.description:
Sign in with ChatGPT to use your ChatGPT plan for eligible requests. Your browser is on a different device, so open this URL on any device signed in to ChatGPT and approve the request:

{auth_url}

The page that opens afterwards will fail to load. Copy the full URL from the address bar and paste it below.

This option does not include speech to text, text to speech or image generation.
